title: A note or a drawing
intro: A short note for your partner, or a drawing that stays in your sent list.
noteHint: E.g. good luck at today's meeting
emptyDrawing: Draw something to be able to send it.
widgetText: It appears on their widget if they allow notes.
drawingHint: Drawings stay in your sent list. Widget notes are text-only for now.
unpairedText: You need to be connected with your partner to send a note or drawing.
deleteConfirmText: It leaves your sent list. Notes also leave your partner's widget.
deleteError: Couldn't delete right now. Try again.
emptyText: When you send a note or a drawing, it shows up here.

errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment.
errors(map).NOT_PAIRED: To send this, you need to be connected with your partner in the app.
errors(map).other: Couldn't send right now. What you wrote is still here.
